breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions: Dirichlet and periodic. The ground truth resolved this by removing the incorrect periodic condition. The generated specification correctly omits any mention of periodic boundaries and only states to 'Apply Dirichlet boundary conditions with u=0 on all four edges', thus fixing the inconsistency.
